snippet.title: Shootout! Magnavox Odyssey 1972
snippet.description:
Shootout! is a shooter video game released in 1972 for Magnavox Odyssey. It uses the game card 9, an overlay and the light gun (rifle).

One player is a bandit in an Old West town, and moves along a path, stopping at windows for the other player to try to shoot with the light gun.

Player 1 is the SHERIFF with the rifle. Player 2 is the DALTON GANG. Player 2 uses his HORIZONTAL and VERTICAL controls to position his Light in the first floor windows of Charley’s Saloon. Player 2 makes his way down the length of the entire top block. He must remain in each window and doorway for the time It takes him to say, “You'll Never Get me, Sheriff!’ When Player 2 gets to the end of the block, he runs across the street via the horse.

The Player Control Unit is then traded for the Rifle. The procedure is repeated. The winner is the Sheriff who gets most men in The Dalton Gang.

Source: https://archive.org/details/OdySim/page/44/mode/2up

Gameplay: OdySim Simulator 1080p 60 FPS
